mapper.select: SELECT report.id, project.project_name AS projectName, task.task_name AS taskName, report.sample_count AS sampleCount, report.pass_count AS passCount, report.reject_count AS rejectCount, report.pass_rate AS passRate, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(report.problem_summary_json, '$')) AS problemSummary FROM label_qc_report report JOIN label_project project ON project.id = report.project_id LEFT JOIN label_task task ON task.id = report.task_id WHERE report.deleted = 0 ORDER BY report.id DESC
SELECT id, sample_count AS sampleCount, pass_count AS passCount, reject_count AS rejectCount, pass_rate AS passRate FROM label_qc_report WHERE deleted = 0 AND id = #{id}
SELECT project_id FROM label_job WHERE id = #{jobId}

SELECT rule.id, project.project_name AS projectName, task.task_name AS taskName, rule.sample_rate AS sampleRate, rule.min_sample_count AS minSampleCount, rule.status FROM label_qc_rule rule LEFT JOIN label_project project ON project.id = rule.project_id LEFT JOIN label_task task ON task.id = rule.task_id WHERE rule.deleted = 0 ORDER BY rule.id DESC
SELECT id, project_id AS projectId, task_id AS taskId, sample_rate AS sampleRate, min_sample_count AS minSampleCount, status FROM label_qc_rule WHERE deleted = 0 AND id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE label_qc_rule SET project_id = #{projectId}, task_id = #{taskId}, sample_rate = #{sampleRate}, min_sample_count = #{minSampleCount}, status = #{status}, updated_by = #{userId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
